per_candidate.id: s2:Are Persistent Emission Luminosity and Rotation Measure of Fast Radio Bursts Rel
s2:A nebular origin for the persistent radio emission of fast radio bursts

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the specific question of additional factors accounting for low rotation measures of FRBs near the Galactic plane. They are either unrelated or only adjacent, discussing related topics without addressing the specific discrepancies in detection rates and RM near the Galactic plane.
